eye_tracking.title: Eye Tracking Devices
eye_tracking.description: Eye gaze technology for ALS communication when hand/voice function is lost

devices.name: Tobii Eye Tracker 4C
devices.community_verdict: Good option for Windows Eye Control - used by experienced PALS
key_notes: Native Windows Eye Control support
Windows compatible
Only available second-hand now
Install Tobii Core Software for full functionality
devices.warning: Discontinued by Tobii. Check eBay, Facebook Marketplace for used units.

devices.name: Tobii Eye Tracker 5
devices.community_verdict: Good but needs driver workaround. Does NOT support Windows Eye Control natively!
key_notes: Gaming device - NOT designed for accessibility
Requires beta driver installation to work with windows eye control
Works with OptiKey
devices.warning: Does NOT work with Windows Eye Control by design. Use OptiKey instead.

devices.name: Tobii Dynavox PCEye 5
devices.price_note: Pricing depends on region and software bundle.
devices.community_verdict: Purpose-built eye access for a separate Windows computer.
key_notes: TD Control is included for computer access; check which communication apps are included in your quote.
Supports indoor and outdoor use, with compatible displays up to 27 inches.
The computer, mounting and local training may be separate costs.
devices.india_access: Ask Tobii Dynavox or its regional partner about assessment, supply and support.

devices.name: Tobii Dynavox TD I-16
devices.price_note: A configured communication system; no fixed India price verified.
devices.community_verdict: Integrated eye tracking, speech output and Windows access.
key_notes: 15.6-inch screen, built-in speakers and a rear-facing Partner Window for conversations.
Includes TD Talk, TD Control and other communication software; confirm the regional bundle.
Manufacturer specifies approximately 6.5 hours average battery runtime, up to 8 hours. Actual use varies.
devices.india_access: Request a regional quote with mounting, training, warranty and repair arrangements.

devices.name: Eyegaze Edge
devices.price_note: Assessment and configuration determine the package price.
devices.community_verdict: Worth an individual assessment when eye tracking is difficult.
key_notes: Manufacturer describes adaptations for drooping eyelids and limited eye movement.
Dry eyes can still affect tracking. Successful use needs individual positioning and calibration.
Ask for a demonstration with the intended user; these features do not guarantee success for every person.
devices.india_access: Confirm international supply, local support and a full written quote with Eyegaze.

head_tracking.title: Head Tracking Devices
head_tracking.description: For people who retain comfortable, repeatable head movement.

devices.name: GlassOuse V1.4
devices.price_note: Manufacturer price for the device; switches and import costs may be extra.
devices.community_verdict: A glasses-style head mouse for compatible computers, phones and tablets.
key_notes: Uses a 9-axis sensor to translate head movement into pointer movement.
Click with a compatible 3.5 mm adaptive switch or dwell software.
Manufacturer advertises 150+ hours per charge. Check comfort, calibration and device compatibility during a trial.
devices.india_access: Confirm shipping and after-sales support with GlassOuse before ordering.

devices.name: HeadMouse Nano
devices.price_note: Check device, switch and software bundle pricing with Origin Instruments.
devices.community_verdict: A screen-mounted alternative to wearing a head mouse.
key_notes: Tracks a small reflective target worn on the forehead, glasses or a hat.
USB powered; works on systems that support a standard USB mouse. Mobile devices may need an adapter.
Selection needs an adaptive switch or dwell software. An onscreen keyboard provides typing.
devices.india_access: Confirm an India supply route, accessories and warranty with Origin Instruments.

emg_muscle_switches.title: EMG & Muscle Switches
emg_muscle_switches.description: For locked-in patients with residual muscle twitches

devices.name: NeuroNode Trilogy
key_notes: Detects nerve firing even without visible movement
Place sensor on any muscle with residual activity
Eliminates dwell time - 47% faster typing
Combines EMG switching with eye gaze targeting
devices.community_verdict: Premium but essential for true locked-in syndrome. Only option for some patients.

bci.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs)
bci.description: For late-stage when eye tracking becomes difficult. Currently in clinical trials only.
bci.warning: These systems are investigational for restoring everyday communication. Trial participation depends on eligibility and study location. Research sales or clearance of an electrode component do not mean approval of a complete home communication system. There is no confirmed general-release date.

devices.name: Synchron Stentrode
devices.invasiveness: Implanted through a blood vessel via the jugular vein.
key_notes: The US COMMAND feasibility study completed 12-month safety follow-up in six participants, according to Synchron.
Current studies explore digital-device control in people with severe paralysis. The sponsor describes trials in the US and Australia.
Synchron states that the system is not approved for commercial use in any geography.
devices.india_access: The cited sponsor pages do not list an India study site.

devices.name: Neuralink Telepathy & VOICE
devices.invasiveness: A surgically implanted N1 device records brain signals.
key_notes: Neuralink reported 21 participants on 28 January 2026. This is a dated sponsor report, not a live total.
Its trial programme covers computer control and speech restoration. The VOICE study (NCT07224256) investigates output of intended speech as text or audio.
VOICE lists UT Southwestern in the US. A worldwide registry does not guarantee trial enrolment or local access.
devices.india_access: Check the sponsor’s study-site list; registry access is not an India treatment service.

devices.name: BrainGate
key_notes: Research includes computer access and decoding intended speech in people with paralysis.
The consortium’s 2026 publications include intended-speech decoding in a participant with longstanding anarthria and locked-in syndrome.
Results in individual research participants do not predict everyone’s outcome. Participation requires specialist assessment and repeated research sessions.
devices.india_access: BrainGate’s participation page lists US sites and a nearby-residence requirement.

devices.name: Paradromics Connexus
devices.invasiveness: Surgically implanted brain interface and chest implant.
key_notes: The sponsor announced the first Connect-One implantation on 17 June 2026 and an expanded personal-computing study pathway on 26 August 2026.
The study evaluates intended-speech decoding and computer access in people with severe motor impairment.
US study participation requires eligibility screening, residence near a study centre and a substantial long-term commitment.
devices.india_access: Connect-One is currently listed as a US-only study.

research_devices.name: Precision Layer 7
research_devices.invasiveness: A thin electrode array placed on the brain surface.
key_notes: The April 2025 announcement describes FDA clearance for recording, monitoring and stimulation for implantation of up to 30 days.
This clearance concerns the cortical electrode array. Precision identifies its complete BCI as investigational and unavailable for US sale.
A cleared component does not establish approval or effectiveness for long-term home ALS communication.
research_devices.india_access: No home communication product or India access was verified.

research_devices.name: Cognixion ONE Axon-R
research_devices.invasiveness: A non-invasive EEG and augmented-reality headset.
key_notes: Combines brain-signal sensing with a visual interface for communication research.
Cognixion states that Axon-R is for research use only and is not approved or cleared by the FDA or Health Canada.
Research or educational purchase is different from an approved communication aid for home care.
research_devices.india_access: Confirm study eligibility with the research team; an India home-care service was not verified.

free_software.title: Free & Open Source Software
free_software.description: These FREE tools can dramatically reduce costs for ALS communication

software.name: Windows Eye Control
software.community_verdict: Mouse control, an onscreen keyboard and text-to-speech with a compatible eye tracker.
features: Requires supported eye-tracking hardware; a regular webcam is not enough.
Microsoft lists the Tobii 4C among supported devices. Eye Tracker 5 is not supported.
The Eye Control keyboard uses the US English layout. Confirm drivers for your Windows version.

software.name: OptiKey
software.community_verdict: Eye-controlled typing, speech output and computer access.
features: Choose Pro, Chat, Mouse or Symbol according to the functions needed.
Tobii 4C and Eye Tracker 5 require OptiKey Classic v3; they are not supported in v4.
Needs a compatible input device. OptiKey itself does not turn an ordinary webcam into an eye tracker.

software.name: Enable Viacam (eViacam)
software.status: Legacy Windows release; Linux packages available
software.community_verdict: Moves the pointer by tracking head movement with a webcam.
features: Includes dwell clicking and adjustable pointer movement; requires usable head movement.
Official Windows download is v2.1.0 and lists Windows through version 10. Windows 11 compatibility is not established by that page.
Linux builds remain packaged by Debian. This is head tracking, not eye tracking.

software.name: GazePointer
software.community_verdict: A webcam-based gaze pointer for experimentation.
features: Estimates gaze direction and moves the mouse pointer; separate software is needed for typing or speech.
Project distribution is dated 2019. Current Windows compatibility and individual accuracy need testing.
The listed non-commercial licence is not an unrestricted open-source licence.

mobile_apps.title: Mobile Apps
mobile_apps.description: Smartphone and tablet apps for communication

apps.name: Look to Speak
apps.community_verdict: Select saved phrases or pictures with eye gestures and have them spoken aloud.
features: Uses the phone’s camera; this is phrase selection rather than full eye-controlled typing.
Phrasebooks can be personalised. Google Play lists its last update as 29 May 2024.
Position the phone steadily and test speech volume. A Bluetooth speaker is optional and is not a monitored emergency alarm.

apps.name: Apple Eye Tracking
apps.community_verdict: Use gaze and dwell selection to operate a supported iPhone or iPad.
features: Uses the front camera, with calibration and a stable, well-lit view of the face.
Requires iOS 18 / iPadOS 18 or later and a supported model. Check Apple’s compatibility list for your exact device.
Combine an accessible keyboard with speech software when needed; Eye Tracking itself is an input method.

apps.name: Avaz AAC
apps.community_verdict: Picture and text-based communication with speech output and Indian vocabulary.
features: Includes a keyboard and predictive text alongside symbol-based vocabulary.
India version supports English and six regional languages. On iOS, choose India within the combined Avaz AAC app.
Prices are Avaz’s published India plans; confirm the applicable store price and trial terms.

apps.name: Google Project Relate
apps.community_verdict: Personalised recognition for people who still have speech that others find difficult to understand.
features: Google says existing users can continue using their speech models; new sign-ups are currently closed.
Current features include transcription, spoken repetition and a Relate keyboard for voice typing.
This requires speech input and does not provide eye-controlled communication for someone who cannot speak.

apps.name: Apple Live Speech
apps.platform: Supported iPhone / iPad / Mac / Apple Watch
apps.community_verdict: Type a message and speak it aloud in conversation or supported calls.
features: Save favourite phrases and use the device speaker, Phone or FaceTime.
Requires a supported device and iOS 17, iPadOS 17, macOS Sonoma or watchOS 10 or later.
An additional input method may be needed if typing by touch is difficult.

low_tech.title: Low-Tech Solutions
low_tech.description: Simple, reliable, and highly valued by the community

tools.name: Alphabet Board
tools.description: Take a physical whiteboard and divide it into 6 groups, each with 6 letters. The last group has numbers. Caregiver first confirms the group from PALS, then iterates over the letters.
tools.why_essential: Works when you cannot guess common words or PALS need to say something new. Keep this handy as you cannot use an eye tracker all the time.

tools.name: Bell/Buzzer Systems
tools.community_verdict: Motion sensor bell , Push button bell

voice_banking.title: Voice Banking
voice_banking.description: CRITICAL - Create a synthetic voice clone BEFORE speech declines
voice_banking.community_warning: Multiple PALS members regret NOT doing this early. DO IT NOW.
voice_banking.what_is_it: Record your natural voice so a computer can speak in YOUR voice later
requirements: Do it BEFORE speech becomes slurred

key_recommendations.title: Voice Bank IMMEDIATELY
key_recommendations.description: Don't wait. Record your voice while it's still clear.

key_recommendations.title: Trial the complete eye-tracking setup
key_recommendations.description: Match the tracker, software version and positioning to the person. Tobii 4C and Eye Tracker 5 require OptiKey Classic v3.

key_recommendations.title: Always have Alphabet Board as backup
key_recommendations.description: Most effective tool according to 6-year PALS user. Works when tech fails.

key_recommendations.title: Try Look to Speak for saved phrases
key_recommendations.description: Test positioning and audibility; it is not a monitored caregiver alarm.
key_recommendations.cost: Free app; optional speaker cost varies.

review_note: Product details and official links checked 11 September 2026. Prices are published reference prices, not India purchase quotes. Confirm availability, tax, shipping, accessories and support with the supplier.
